يظطلم (form VIII)
# يَظْطَلِمُ (yaẓṭalimu) /jaðˤ.tˤa.li.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
# يَظْطَلِمَ (yaẓṭalima) /jaðˤ.tˤa.li.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
# يَظْطَلِمْ (yaẓṭalim) /jaðˤ.tˤa.lim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
